name: Shinohara Mayumi
source:
[url=/c88591]Shinohara Mizuho[/url]'s mother.
She divorced her husband when Mizuho was in kindergarten. Since then, she has raised her as a single mom.
She never wants her daughter to feel the same way, so she keeps a close eye on her, especially  when it is about Mizuho's relationships with the opposite sex.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
